interactionTrace.input: Workbench mode selection was exercised while tracing; DevTools labeled the no-navigation trace URL as /compose despite the live page remaining on /workbench, so the sample is not attributed to a specific route.

limitations: Chrome DevTools MCP returned trace summaries but denied raw trace file export outside its own configured workspace roots.
CrUX field data, an attributable route-level INP, FCP, TBT, and Speed Index were not available from these traces.
The Vite >500 KB raw chunk warning maps to a Gold resource module chunk measured at 868549 bytes raw and 175090 bytes gzip; this is lazy renderer data and remains within the Workbench gzip budget.
assessment: Cold-load LCP and CLS pass on homepage, Compose, and Workbench at desktop/mobile. CSS render-blocking was reported with zero estimated FCP/LCP savings. No actionable performance defect was identified in these traces.
